notes.en: Button strength determines pillar distance (LK close, MK middle, HK far); holding the button results in a delayed activation
Button combination determines pillar distance (LK+MK close, LK+HK middle, MK+HK far); holding the buttons results in a delayed activation

Occurs automatically when Cruel Shoulder connects with a placed Divine Pillar (startup is counted from the frame Arjun reaches the pillar); will auto-correct if Arjun is behind the opponent when swinging the pillar; no difference between strengths of Cruel Shoulder or Divine Pillar (including OD versions)

Absorbs any strike or projectile attack (including Super Arts) without incurring any recoverable damage; automatically performs a counter-attack when absorbing a strike (but not a projectile); can walk forward or backward while holding button (walk speed: 0.02 in either direction); counter-attack will autocorrect to face the opponent if they switch sides
11-hit OD-priority projectile hitbox; can be used to safely pressure without the threat of Drive Impact or reversal SA1

12-hit Super-priority projectile hitbox; aims near the ground before sweeping outward and upward (less range on early active frames but reaches fullscreen on the final 2 hits); can hit cross-up (even on grounded opponents if they extend a forward hurtbox while behind Arjun); useful juggle ender; can be used as an anti-fireball tool at mid range (less like to punish if clashing with multiple projectile hits)
Cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Arjun
Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Arjun
3f extra recovery on whiff
No difference between button strengths; projectile dissipates on contact with opponent
2 hits; projectile moves forward slightly while active; can input follow-up even after projectile connects with opponent

Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)

Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)
3f extra recovery on whiff

Fully cancelable sweep with good range; cancel does not allow a combo follow-up on grounded hit or counter-hit (requires Punish Counter or airborne juggle); Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG bounce state with extra hitstop for an easy hitconfirm; useful juggle tool that keeps the opponent airborne but only has slight juggle potential itself; forward movement leaves Arjun very close to the opponent on block if not canceled; cancel into 236LP creates a safe frame trap on block; Arjun lifts up his front leg hurtbox on frames 6-14, making it strong vs. low pokes; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; extends a projectile invincible head hurtbox upwards on frames 2-17 (but still in a crouching state)

Fully cancelable sweep with good range; cancel does not allow a combo follow-up on grounded hit or counter-hit (requires Punish Counter or airborne juggle); Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG bounce state with extra hitstop for an easy hitconfirm; useful juggle tool that keeps the opponent airborne but only has slight juggle potential itself; forward movement leaves Arjun very close to the opponent on block if not canceled; cancel into 236LP creates a safe frame trap on block; Arjun lifts up his front leg hurtbox on frames 6-14, making it strong vs. low pokes; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; extends a projectile invincible head hurtbox upwards on frames 2-17 (but still in a crouching state)
Side switch; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

"Hmmm. This will not end well for you."; tosses a rock into the air, creating a large projectile hitbox when his breath collides with it; hitbox whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; deals 200 recoverable damage on block
; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles
Allows the TC to combo after a 5HK Punish Counter launch (full charge) or a high anti-air connect (partial charge)
1f less recovery on block
Always a true blockstring; HP/HK follow-ups can only be input on hit
Chases the opponent down for strong midscreen oki; cannot be input on block
() refers to scaled damage from 5HP~HP combo starter; cannot be input on block; only combos in the corner (opponent is too far to connect midscreen)
2f less recovery on block
3f gap between hits on block; knocks down on counter-hit/Punish Counter (canceling into Super does not combo off the knockdown)

"You challenge me? You stand no chance. Ahh... haha. Your move. Your lack of rhythm disturbs me."; can change which dance Arjun performs by holding a direction (forward/back/up/down) and extend the taunt indefinitely

Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing)

Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 600 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing)

Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 700 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing)

Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing)

Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; can be comboed into on grounded opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals

Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; takes a step forward on startup similar to 236PP; can be comboed into on grounded or airborne opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals
Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Reversal|Drive Reversal]].

Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Reversal|Drive Reversal]].
"One moment. There. Many thanks."
See [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Impact|Drive Impact]]. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

Reaches farther downward than Arjun's other air normals (more likely to punish whiffed normals / projectiles / throw techs and harder to anti-air on reaction); knocks down the opponent on any hit (no follow-up combo is possible making it less rewarding than most air normals); lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

Cross-up (can connect even from a point blank forward jump); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 1st active frame can only hit forward while the final active frame can only hit cross-up (2 separate hitboxes overlap during the middle 4 active frames); extends a large downward hurtbox that makes it vulnerable to otherwise weak anti-airs (like many 5LP/2LP/2MP attacks); lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)
Strong downward hitbox priority; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead if the opponent is in Burnout
Fast air-to-air with strong horizontal hitbox priority
Greatest horizontal range of Arjun's air normals; lower body projectile invuln 9-26f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)
Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)
; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

See [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Parry|Drive Parry]]. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

See [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Rush|Drive Rush]]; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

See [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Rush|Drive Rush]]; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: ? (min/throw), ? (min/block), ? (max/final DR frame)
